_ 1. The moratorium imposed herein incorporates the findings and statements set forth in the preceding “WHEREAS” clauses and such clauses are made a part of this resolution. For the purposes of this resolution, “solar farm” means a development, project, facility or operation, ten (10) acres or more in size, that contains, consists of or houses equipment or infrastructure related to or in connection with the gathering, obtaining, delivering or transmitting of solar energy or power.

- 2. From the date of adoption of this resolution until 180 days from its adoption, notwithstanding any provision of the Code or County ordinance or regulation to the contrary, there shall be a complete moratorium on the acceptance of any applications relating to the establishment, construction, development and/or operation of new solar farms or the expansion of currently existing or under development solar farms, including any applications for special land use permits, rezonings, zonings, land disturbance permits, building permits, business licenses, or certificates of occupancy, in the unincorporated areas of the County and no licenses with respect to the establishment, expansion or development of the same shall be acted upon in the unincorporated areas of the County.

- 3. The BOC will study the effects of solar farms on the health, safety and welfare of the County’s residents and businesses and report its findings

4, This moratorium will expire at 11:59 p.m. on the 180t" day from the adoption of this resolution, unless shortened or extended by official action of the BOC.

_ 5, The provisions of this resolution are severable and should any part of this resolution be deemed by a court of competent jurisdiction to be invalid, such
